request.style: English, anthemic rock, strong female vocal with gang shouts, crunchy rhythm guitars, bass, big drums, determined and uplifting, 124 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The walls were down, the gates were burned
The city lay in shame
Nehemiah rode by moonlight
And he came back with a flame

[Chorus]
Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem
Let us start rebuilding
The God of heaven will give us success
Let us start rebuilding

[Verse]
Sanballat laughed and Tobiah sneered
What is this you are doing
But they set their hands to the good work
And they kept on with the building

[Chorus]
Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem
Let us start rebuilding
The God of heaven will give us success
Let us start rebuilding

[Bridge]
A trowel in one hand, a sword in the other
Sister by sister and brother by brother
In fifty-two days the wall was finished
For this work had been accomplished by our God

[Outro]
Let us start rebuilding
Let us start rebuilding
